outcome: Pulsatility index (PI) in the umbilical artery (UA)
PI in the middle cerebral artery (MCA)
cohort: 30 fetuses at risk for preterm birth.
finding: Antenatal corticosteroid administration was associated with a significant decrease in the umbilical artery pulsatility index but no significant change in the middle cerebral artery PI.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at betamethasone administration: 30.2 +/- 2.59 weeks
